corrections.why: Sources describe an L-4 cab with a catwalk on concrete footings, reached by ladders for the last 80 feet. That is an elevated lookout cab, not a ground-level site. The editor should confirm the kind vocabulary.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled by Margaret Sand, Walde Lookout and Cindy Schacher, June 2016)

notes_for_editor: The 1931 build and the ruins-from-1961 date agree across four sources. The 1943 smokechaser names come from one Idaho Fire Lookouts page and are not confirmed elsewhere. The brief's kind 'ground' is proposed as 'tower' in corrections; check the vocabulary. The Forest Service list places the site at Sec 31 T39N R8E, which matches the brief's township. No source describes what stands on the rock today. Idaho lists it as hike-in ruins only. Two Facebook leads (6C Idaho History, 1954 Chateau Rock lookout photo exhibit, and a Kelly Frazier post dated November 10, 2021) were found, but only their titles were readable, so no photos were added. Access is recorded as public with a caution about the rock scramble, not as an invitation to climb.
